texts.content: {"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 9], "size": 12.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "相府真千金归来那日"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 8], "size": 12.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "假千金成了白月光"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 11], "size": 12.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "爹娘在我眉间找她的影子"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 8], "size": 12.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "兄长咒我替她去死"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 9], "size": 12.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "夫君同床时唤她的名"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 9], "size": 12.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "攻略失败的最后一刻"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 13], "size": 12.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "我对系统说：让他们的白月光"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 12.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "我不想再争了"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 12], "size": 12.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "原以为是再简单不过的任务"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 10], "size": 12.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "只需要在十八岁生辰时"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 13], "size": 12.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "得到哪怕一个亲人的真心祝福"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 12.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "便算攻略成功"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 10], "size": 12.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "就能改变我早死的结局"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 12.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "爹娘还是照旧"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 12.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": []}], "text": "去给谢茵扫墓"}
